What is localsend?

LocalSend lets you send files and messages between nearby devices - phones, laptops, desktops, whatever - over your local Wi-Fi, without needing the internet or any cloud account. It uses an encrypted REST API over HTTPS to move files directly between devices, and works across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Think of it as a free, cross-platform, privacy-respecting AirDrop.

Install localsend on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add localsend

Good to know

  • Sending device must be reachable over a local network (Wi-Fi/LAN) with the receiving device
